raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":1870,"db":"MYSQL","query":"WITH d2024 AS (SELECT c.department_id, AVG(cnt) AS avg_enroll_2024 FROM (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id) t JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.department_id), d2025 AS (SELECT c.department_id, AVG(cnt) AS avg_enroll_2025 FROM (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id) t JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.department_id) SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, ROUND(COALESCE(d2024.avg_enroll_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_enroll_2024, ROUND(COALESCE(d2025.avg_enroll_2025, 0), 2) AS avg_enroll_2025 FROM education_2025.department d LEFT JOIN d2024 ON d2024.department_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN d2025 ON d2025.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY avg_enroll_2025 DESC, d.department_id ASC LIMIT 5;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"比较2024与2025学期一中每个院系的平均选课学生数，按院系的课程汇总的选课人数均值","tables":["MYSQL:education_2024.enrollment","MYSQL:education_2024.course","MYSQL:education_2025.enrollment","MYSQL:education_2025.course"],"columns":["semester_id","is_withdraw","course_id","department_id"]},{"requirement":"排除退课","tables":["MYSQL:education_2024.enrollment","MYSQL:education_2025.enrollment"],"columns":["is_withdraw"]},{"requirement":"返回两年院系平均选课人数前5，按2025均值降序","tables":["MYSQL:education_2025.department"],"columns":["department_id","department_name"]}],"assumptions":["问题未明确要求去重学生，按选课记录数统计每门课程的选课人数","问题未明确要求只返回两年都存在的院系，使用2025年院系表左连接两年聚合结果，缺失年份均值按0处理"]}
